subject: Quarterly readiness: consolidated forecast, timelines, and mitigation log
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly readiness snapshot and asks (QBR)

Team —

As we prepare the QBR packet for the execs, I need a short, factual snapshot of the current roadmap commitments, launch timeline, and the top 3 delivery risks with proposed mitigations. Please keep this concise — I want to fold these into the QBR readout slide deck.

Action items (please reply inline or update the attached Readout_matrix_v1.xlsx):
- Confirm target launch window (calendar date) and hard feature-freeze date.
- Confirm whether analytics ingestion and API contract work are on-track or at risk.
- Call out any infra/ops capacity or SLA gaps that would affect the launch.
- Provide owner and ETA for each mitigations item.

Deadline: EOD Thu, Apr 15 (so I can consolidate on Fri).

I attached the Readout_matrix_v1.xlsx as the baseline.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness snapshot and asks (QBR)

On Wed, Apr 14, 2027 at 9:12 AM, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> As we prepare the QBR packet for the execs, I need a short, factual snapshot...

Quick update from Product:
- Launch candidate: May 27, 2027 (end-user availability target).
- Feature-freeze (code merge freeze): May 6, 2027. Post-freeze changes limited to critical bug fixes only.
- Scope change: we are trimming the initial telemetry exports (non-blocking) to reduce test surface; core analytics ingestion remains in scope and required for the revenue telemetry KPI.

Open dependency: Analytics ingestion (ENG-462) requires a dedicated test harness from DataInfra to validate throughput. If we cannot secure the test env by Apr 20, we risk slipping the validation window.

Attached: launch_timeline_v2.pdf (timeline + gating criteria).

I'll own the product gating checklist and will update Readout_matrix by EOD Apr 15.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Product Management
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness snapshot and asks (QBR) — engineering risk register

On Wed, Apr 14, 2027 at 11:08 AM, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick update from Product:
> - Launch candidate: May 27, 2027...

Engineering risk summary (top items):
1) Autoscaler regression in multi-tenant path (ENG-489) — Severity: High. Impact: underprovisioned p99 latency on long-tail requests. Mitigation: revert problematic change and run extended soak on staging. Owner: Karthik. ETA: Apr 23.
2) KV-cache serialization edge-case causing warm-start failures (ENG-502) — Severity: Medium. Mitigation: add guard to cache loader + backfill test. Owner: Naomi. ETA: Apr 22.
3) Quantization regressions in latest build (affects gpt-style model backends) — Severity: Medium. Mitigation: pin quantization profile for release candidate, dev/qa to validate output parity. Owner: ML infra (cc'd Vivek). ETA: Apr 25.

Notes: The autoscaler is the only High item that materially threatens the May 27 window; everything else can be mitigated with test parity and a short freeze. I'll schedule a 30-minute risk triage on Apr 16 to validate progress and surface blockers for execs if we can't meet ETAs.

Attached: risk_register_qbr.csv (compact register + owners).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
SVP Engineering, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Ashley <ashley@acme.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness snapshot and asks (QBR) — Acme integration note

Sergio / Lauren —

Quick heads up from Acme: our API contract finalization hit an internal procurement delay. Our current ETA for sign-off is May 3 instead of Apr 28. That pushes our full integration testing window by ~3 business days.

Questions:
- Would Redwood be willing to support a short soft-launch pattern (feature flag gating for Acme-specific features) to reduce the blast radius if we miss early integration validation?
- If the autoscaler risk Karthik mentions materializes, can you confirm if there's a fallback model variant we can route Acme to for the first 48 hours?

We're happy to coordinate test plans; Ashley (Product, Acme).

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ashley <ashley@acme.com>, QuantumCloud Procurement <procure@quantumcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated decisions & mitigation log — QBR packet (finalize by Apr 16)

Thanks all — consolidated below so I can lock the QBR deck this morning and publish to execs. Please ack or update inline.

Decisions / confirmed dates:
- Target GA launch: May 27, 2027.
- Code freeze (merge freeze): May 6, 2027. No non-critical merges post-freeze.

Primary risks and mitigations (owners + ETAs):
- Autoscaler regression (High) — Owner: Karthik. Action: revert problematic change, run soak on staging. ETA: Apr 23.
- Analytics ingestion test env availability (Medium) — Owner: Lauren / DataInfra. Action: confirm test harness; contingency: partial telemetry mock if test env delayed. ETA: Apr 20.
- KV-cache warm-starts (Medium) — Owner: Naomi. Action: guard + backfill test. ETA: Apr 22.
- Acme API contract delay (External) — Owner: Product + Partnerships. Action: enable feature-flag soft-launch for Acme; test plan to start May 4. Product to confirm.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Karthik: complete autoscaler remediation and validate by Apr 23.
- Naomi: complete KV-cache fix and provide test results by Apr 22.
- Lauren: confirm analytics test env readiness by Apr 20 and update timeline doc.
- Vivek: confirm capacity reservation with infra/ops for the May 27 window by Apr 21.
- Sergio: consolidate slides and publish QBR packet to Drive.

Attachments: QBR_readiness_packet_v1.pptx (consolidated slides + mitigation log). Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-readiness. Slack channel: #qbr-readiness. JIRA references: ENG-462, ENG-489.

I'll finalize the deck at 11:00 today and share with execs at 12:00. If any ETA slips, flag immediately in this thread so I can update exec-facing notes.

Ack if you see your actions and ETAs are correct.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
